headline: B200 leads weekly gains at +14% as hyperscaler premiums stay wide across all GPU classes.
bullets: B200's market index sits at $7.99 after a +14% move over 7 days, the largest weekly change in the set, with hyperscalers at $14.12 versus $7.99 at neoclouds.
H100 SXM carries the steepest hyperscaler premium at +162%, with a $10.68 hyperscaler median against $4.07 at neoclouds and a +7% weekly rise to a $4.32 index.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour and was flat at +0% on the week, with RunPod Community Cloud listing it at $0.50.
H200 rose +6% to a $5.40 index, while A100 80GB SXM gained +5% to $2.70 and is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour.
L40S was the only GPU to soften, at -1% over 7 days, holding a $1.50 index with Vast.ai cheapest at $0.60.
watch: Whether B200's +14% weekly climb continues or eases, given its $14.12 hyperscaler median and +77% premium over neoclouds.
